content.thinking:
ASan cannot run in this sandbox (/proc is not mounted). So I can't test ASan locally. I'll test UBSan only, and carefully review the code for memory issues manually (ASan would catch buffer overruns and leaks).

Let me run UBSan builds and the test suite.

Also, to partially substitute for ASan/valgrind: is valgrind installed? Let me check. If yes, run memcheck on some cases to catch overreads/leaks.

arguments.command:
which valgrind; cd /work/tmp && g++ -std=c++17 -O1 -g -fsanitize=undefined -fno-sanitize-recover=all -Wall -Wextra /work/submit/planb64.cpp -o /tmp/planb64_ub 2>&1 | tail -3; echo compiled
UB=/tmp/planb64_ub
export UBSAN_OPTIONS=print_stacktrace=1:halt_on_error=1
$UB build /work/examples/fib.txt /tmp/u.idx && cmp /tmp/u.idx /work/examples/expected.idx && echo UB_BUILD_OK
$UB lookup /tmp/u.idx /work/examples/trace.txt batch 7 | cmp - /work/examples/expected.txt && echo UB_BATCH_OK
$UB build sfib.txt /tmp/u2.idx && python3 ref.py build sfib.txt | cmp - /tmp/u2.idx && echo UB_BIG_BUILD_OK
$UB lookup /tmp/u2.idx strace.txt scalar > /tmp/u2.out && python3 ref.py lookup /tmp/u2.idx strace.txt | cmp - /tmp/u2.out && echo UB_BIG_LOOKUP_OK
./errs.sh 2>&1 | tail -3
